podcast.body: This album was originally slated for release on September 15, 2009, as the first part of a two-part set. However, its release was indefinitely postponed due to Adam Yauch's cancer diagnosis, ultimately being shelved. "The first release date for the new album was set as September 15, 2009. It was going to be called Hot Sauce Committee Part One, the first of a two-part set."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
